title: Intraoperative analysis of tumor tissue using stimulated Raman histology and the NIO Laser Imaging System.
summary: The intraoperative frozen section is an everyday tool for the surgeon to gain orienting insights into tumor entity and infiltrative tumor tissue growth. Using Raman spectroscopy based tissue analysis, the NIO Laser Imaging System is able to generate and analyze digital tissue images within minutes. The aim of this study is to further validate this novel device and to answer specific questions related to fluorescent agents used in surgery. To answer this question, small portions of the tissue obtained during tumor resection will still be analyzed intraoperatively using the NIO Laser Imaging System and later correlated with clinical data.
conditions: Malignant neoplasm of spinal cord, cranial nerves and other parts of central nervous system
Benign neoplasm of brain and other parts of central nervous system
Neoplasm of uncertain or unknown behaviour of meninges
Neoplasm of uncertain or unknown behaviour of brain and central nervous system

interventions.name: intraoperative rapid section diagnostics by Raman microscopy

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. the patient(s) is (are) of legal age
2. the patient is capable of giving consent
3. the patient(s) is (are) undergoing tumor surgery at the neuro-oncology center of the University Hospital Cologne independently of the study.
4. the patient agrees to participate in the above mentioned study.
Exclusion criteria:
1. lack of consent to participate in the study
2. legal incapacity
